correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md at frozen commit and reconstructed separate fixed-point equations. With \(u=(b-x)/b\), \(H_L(u)=1-b+bu-(1-a)u^d\) is strictly convex with positive endpoints; with \(v=(x-b)/(1-b)\), \(H_R(v)=cv^d-b-(1-b)v\) is strictly concave with negative endpoints. Weighted concavity gives exclusion when \(b\le d\) or \(b\ge1-d\); solving \(H=H' =0\) yields exact \(L(b,d)\), \(R(b,d)\) and interior x coordinates. Endpoint signs force precisely 0, 1, or 2 roots per permitted branch; derivative monotonicity gives the local types and generic one-parameter folds. Joint strict branch conditions give sharp four-root regime \(d<1/2,d<b<1-d\). Independently checked the exact \(a=1/20,b=1/2,c=19/20,d=1/4\) witness via the quartic signs at \(0,3/4,1\). Source verify.py also presents exact witness fractions, but witness alone is not a universal proof.
